parakeet: Religion doesn't just take up space in your head, it hijacks your entire operating system. It tells you what to think instead of teaching you how to think. It replaces confidence with guilt. It swaps out courage for obedience. And worst of all, it teaches you to shrink yourself while making some invisible being the star of your own damn life. You were never meant to live in somebody else's shadow. But here we are, generation after generation, trapped in a belief system that turns powerful people into passive players. When everything is God's plan, you stop making your own. The most dangerous thing you can believe is that your life is not your own. If you believe that every decision, every opportunity, and every outcome has already been predetermined, what's left for you to do? What's your role? The moment you surrender your agency, you give up your ability to shape your own future. And the worst part, you'll never even know what you're capable of. Because instead of taking ownership, you've been conditioned to sit back and wait for permission from the invisible. If everything is God's plan, then by definition, nothing you do matters. You succeed, that was God's will. You fail, well, that was also God's will. You suffer, that's just part of the plan. You thrive, that's also part of the plan. Do you see the problem here? A belief system that explains everything actually explains nothing. It's a cosmic gaslighting scheme, a way to make sure that no matter what happens, you never take full ownership of your own life. Think about it. If you knew without a doubt that no divine force was coming to save you, how much harder would you fight for yourself? And yet billions of people have been taught to sit on the sidelines of their own lives waiting for divine approval. What kind of plan keeps people complacent, obedient, and afraid of their own ambition? What kind of plan tells you that you are a mere pawn in a celestial game you'll never understand? And here's the truth they don't want you to realize. The moment you stop outsourcing your decisions to God's plan, you become a problem because now you're making your own. And nobody who profits off control wants you to be truly free. So the real question is whose plan are you really following? Faith becomes a crutch for inaction.
